1: A wind-scoured stand of dead trees hides a patch of medicinal fungi beneath its roots. Roll Herb Gathering Checks; snapped branches and fresh tracks suggest something fed here recently.
2: A rusted lockbox is wedged beneath the remains of a collapsed roadside depot. DC 13 Thieves' Tools; success = 1d4 Rations + luxury item. Failure = 1d4 Rations.
3: Veil-tainted fog pours through a broken tree line, reducing visibility to 30 ft and imposing Disadvantage on Perception checks. DC 12 Survival; success = hold course. Failure = become disoriented and lose 1 hex.
4: A buried generator housing pulses beneath ash and shattered concrete. DC 13 Tinker's Tools; success = recover an Amber Charge Bundle. Failure = a live cable lashes out for 8d6 force damage.
5: The only route through a ravine has collapsed, leaving loose shale over a long drop. DC 12 Athletics or Acrobatics; success = cross safely. Failure = take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
6: A pre-Sundering chapel has been stripped of anything useful; only a cracked font and a rusted bell remain. DC 12 Religion; success = recover holy water and gain one automatic success on the next Death Save. Failure = falling masonry deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage.
7: A concrete irrigation ditch still carries clean water beneath a tangle of roots. Roll Herb Gathering Checks; an overturned ration tin nearby has been picked clean.
8: A burned-out armory wagon lies split open, its ammunition tins warped and leaking powder. DC 14 Tinker's Tools; success = recover an Emerald Charge Grenade and bullets. Failure = exploding rounds deal 3d6 piercing damage.
9: A skeleton is pinned beneath a survey marker, its field notes swollen with rain. DC 12 Investigation; success = decode directions to a hidden stockpile of Rations, Munitions, or Materials. Failure = the notes are ruined, but the badge can be traded to Archivists.
10: A swollen river has erased the trail and carries broken furniture downstream. DC 12 Athletics or Acrobatics; success = ford safely. Failure = lose 1 hex in the current.
11: Faintly luminous fungi grow around a leaking Veil seep; their glow brightens whenever the ground trembles. Roll Herb Gathering Checks; avoid breathing the drifting spores.
12: A shattered roadside shrine is blackened by a recent fire, its offerings scattered in the mud. DC 12 Religion; success = remove 1 Exhaustion or Frightened. Failure = residue on the altar deals 1d4 poison damage.
13: A Veil-twisted tree has torn up the trail, its roots wrapped around a rusted vehicle. DC 11 Athletics; success = clear the path and salvage timber. Failure = lose 1 hex detouring around it.
14: A collapsed field lab is hidden under creepers and windblown ash. DC 13 Tinker's Tools; success = recover a functioning sensor and gain Perception Advantage in this hex. Failure = a damaged cell triggers an encounter and costs 1 hex.
15: A spring runs beneath a ring of silver-leafed shrubs, but animal tracks crowd its muddy edge. Roll Herb Gathering Checks; DC 12 Survival identifies a safe place to fill water skins.
16: A broken Omen Machine prototype spits blue arcs into a flooded ditch. DC 15 Arcana; success = extract Hollowed Residuum. Failure = a discharge deals 3d6 force damage.
17: A shattered power cell leaks residue into the soil. DC 14 Tinker's Tools; success = restore 1 2nd-level or 2 1st-level spell slots. Failure = a flash burns for 1d4 force damage.
18: Fresh claw marks cross a dry creek bed and end at a half-eaten pack. DC 12 Survival; success = recover 1d4 Rations. Failure = follow the tracks into a combat encounter.
19: A collapsed highway overpass offers a narrow pocket of shelter, though something has dragged debris into a nest nearby. DC 12 Perception; success = improve the randomly determined rest location by one category, up to Safe. Failure = no improvement.
20: A buried Bastion cache bears a faded insignia beneath leaf mold. Gain 1 Bastion Resource. DC 12 Survival or Investigation; success = also find 1d4 Hollowed Residuum. Failure = lose 1 hex in unstable ground.
21: A wrecked ambulance is jammed between concrete slabs, its rear doors bent inward. DC 13 Athletics; success = recover medical supplies and 1d4 doses of medicine. Failure = the roof shifts and deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage.
22: A line of rusted road flares leads off the highway into a shallow crater. DC 13 Survival; success = find a sealed emergency kit with 1d4 Rations. Failure = disturb a nest of Veil-touched scavengers and trigger combat.
23: A cracked water tower drips into a chemical-stained puddle. DC 12 Nature or Medicine; success = identify a clean runoff pipe and fill water skins. Failure = contaminated water causes Poisoned until the next short rest.
24: The trail passes through a field of abandoned cars, doors hanging open and glass ground into the dirt. DC 12 Investigation; success = salvage useful Materials. Failure = a concealed alarm draws a hostile patrol.
25: A rockslide has buried the old road and exposed a rusted freight container. DC 13 Athletics; success = clear a narrow route and recover Munitions. Failure = another slide forces a detour and costs 1 hex.
26: A dead radio mast sways above a burned settlement. DC 13 Tinker's Tools; success = recover a working battery and hear a fragment of a distress broadcast. Failure = the mast collapses with a crash that triggers combat.
27: Ash blows across the path in dense sheets, stinging eyes and obscuring landmarks. DC 12 Survival; success = keep the route. Failure = lose 1 hex and suffer Disadvantage on the next Perception check.
28: A hand pump stands beside a cratered road, its handle wrapped in wire. DC 12 Tinker's Tools; success = draw clean water and recover a small tool kit. Failure = the pump backfires, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage.
29: A pack animal lies dead beside scattered supplies, its harness cut cleanly rather than torn. DC 12 Investigation; success = find a hidden pouch of Rations. Failure = miss the warning signs and trigger an ambush.
30: A narrow bridge of welded road signs spans a drainage channel. DC 12 Acrobatics; success = cross safely. Failure = the metal gives way, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage and costing 1d4 Munitions in the water.
31: A collapsed roadside shelter still has a dry cellar beneath it. DC 12 Perception; success = secure a sheltered rest location and recover 1d4 Rations. Failure = the floor gives way and the entrance is blocked.
32: Bright lichen grows around a cracked chemical drum whose hazard markings are nearly gone. DC 13 Nature or Arcana; success = safely recover an alchemical sample. Failure = a leaking vapor cloud causes coughing and Disadvantage on the next Stealth check.
33: A pair of boots is caught in a fence beside a shallow grave. DC 12 Investigation; success = find a supply bundle the dead traveler hid under the stones. Failure = disturb a nest of biting insects and take 1d4 poison damage.
34: A cold draft rises from a storm drain choked with leaves and plastic. DC 13 Survival; success = find a dry passage beneath the flooded road. Failure = lose the trail and spend an hour backtracking.
35: A damaged Omen Machine lens is half-buried in a muddy rut, reflecting a sky that is not there. DC 14 Arcana; success = recover a component worth 1 Bastion Resource. Failure = a pulse disorients the party and costs 1 hex.
36: A pressure wave moves through the grass, flattening it toward the party before the wind arrives. DC 12 Perception; success = take cover. Failure = the blast knocks everyone down and deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage.
37: A supply basket is trapped in the branches of a dead tree above a ravine. DC 12 Athletics; success = retrieve 1d4 Rations. Failure = the branch snaps and the basket falls beyond reach.
38: Two sets of evacuation arrows point in opposite directions on a concrete marker. DC 13 History or Investigation; success = identify the route that avoids the washed-out road. Failure = follow the wrong trail and lose 1 hex.
39: A sinkhole has exposed a buried store cellar beneath a ruined block. DC 13 Athletics or Survival; success = recover Materials from the dry shelves. Failure = the rim collapses and costs an hour to escape.
40: Black birds circle a wrecked convoy and scatter whenever the party approaches. DC 12 Nature; success = locate an intact water cache beneath the lead vehicle. Failure = their alarm calls reveal the party to a nearby threat.
41: A broken bridge spans a fast stream, with one support beam still anchored on either bank. DC 13 Acrobatics or Athletics; success = cross safely. Failure = lose 1d4 Rations to the water and take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
42: A rusted warning bell hangs over a tunnel marked with faded chemical hazard symbols. DC 12 Investigation; success = find a side vent and pass safely. Failure = stale air causes Poisoned until the next short rest.
43: Blue flowers grow in the shadow of a dead tree, surrounded by old boot prints. DC 13 Nature; success = gather herbs that remove one level of Exhaustion when prepared during a rest. Failure = the plants wilt when disturbed.
44: Footprints circle the party's cold campsite, then stop at a patch of bare rock. DC 13 Survival; success = identify a harmless animal and recover its dropped supply pouch. Failure = follow the trail into a dangerous thicket and lose an hour.
45: A cracked aqueduct leaks into a pool below, while loose masonry hangs over the path. DC 12 Perception; success = spot the weak section and collect clean water. Failure = falling stone deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage to one traveler.
46: A rooftop weather vane turns against the wind above a half-collapsed block. DC 12 Arcana; success = predict a safe window to cross the exposed ground. Failure = a static discharge deals 1d6 lightning damage.
47: A warm patch of soil glows amber beneath a crust of frost and ash. DC 13 Investigation; success = recover a small Amber Charge Bundle. Failure = the crust breaks and vents steam for 1d6 fire damage.
48: A low flood wall offers the only dry path across a submerged field. DC 12 Survival; success = follow it without delay. Failure = a hidden gap costs 1 hex and soaks one supply bundle.
49: Tiny bells are strung between the trees around an abandoned campsite. DC 12 Sleight of Hand or Investigation; success = recover the alarm wire and a hidden Munitions cache. Failure = ring the bells and trigger combat.
50: A cracked statue has fallen across a service hatch, one stone hand gripping a corroded key. DC 13 Athletics; success = open a nearby locker containing Materials. Failure = the statue shifts and seals the hatch.
51: A carpet of soft moss covers a slope of unstable shale. DC 12 Nature; success = find a safe descent. Failure = the moss hides loose scree and the party loses 1 hex.
52: A sealed emergency signal lamp glows green inside a shattered bus stop. DC 13 Tinker's Tools; success = recover a working beacon. Failure = the battery flashes, Blinding the nearest traveler until the end of their next turn.
53: A dead tree is hung with scavenged respirators, each filter cut open and empty. DC 12 Investigation; success = find one intact filter hidden under the roots. Failure = disturb a Veil-tainted dust cloud; the party has Disadvantage on its next save against exposure.
54: A freight lift is stuck halfway down a shaft with a sealed crate on its platform. DC 13 Athletics or Tinker's Tools; success = raise the crate and recover 1d4 Munitions. Failure = the lift drops with a crash that attracts danger.
55: Warm air spills from a fissure below the road, carrying the smell of smoke and damp stone. DC 12 Survival; success = find a dry shortcut that saves an hour. Failure = take a wrong passage and lose 1 hex.
56: Rows of hollow concrete posts hum in the wind around a mine entrance. DC 13 Arcana or Performance; success = find the stable route through them. Failure = the vibration deals 1d4 thunder damage to each traveler.
57: A waterlogged pack is snagged under a fallen branch, its contents wrapped in oilskin. DC 12 Athletics; success = recover 1d4 Rations and a usable tool. Failure = the branch shifts and pins the supplies out of reach.
58: A blackened cook site holds one untouched ration tin beneath a layer of ash. DC 13 Investigation; success = recover the food and identify a safe campsite. Failure = a hidden ash pocket bursts, imposing Disadvantage on the next Perception check.
59: A line of stone cairns marks a route through fog; the newest is built from broken Omen Machine parts. DC 12 Survival; success = navigate safely and salvage a component worth 1 Bastion Resource. Failure = wander and lose 1 hex.
60: A cracked bronze pipe feeds a basin where something moves beneath the water. DC 13 Perception; success = draw clean water from the pipe. Failure = a snapping creature bites for 1d6 piercing damage.
61: A narrow ledge is lined with old handholds, but the crosswind carries grit and broken leaves over the drop. DC 13 Athletics; success = cross safely. Failure = lose a carried item and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage.
62: A Drafter route marker has been turned upside down and marked with a fresh warning slash. DC 12 Investigation; success = identify a watched route and find an alternate way. Failure = enter a kill zone and trigger combat.
63: A stand of dead trees drips clean water from its branches into a cracked basin. DC 13 Nature; success = collect enough water for the day. Failure = the water becomes a disorienting mist and costs an hour.
64: Three flat stones mark a buried tin stamped with a Bastion insignia. DC 12 Survival; success = gain 1 Bastion Resource. Failure = the tin is empty and the disturbed ground exposes the party's tracks.
65: An old road sign points toward a settlement erased from every surviving map. DC 13 Investigation; success = find the real trail concealed behind it. Failure = lose 1 hex following the false route.
66: Hanging roots conceal a dry alcove with enough room for the party, but fresh claw marks score the stone. DC 13 Perception; success = confirm the den is empty and secure a Satisfactory rest location. Failure = wake a territorial beast and trigger combat.
67: Polished stones spiral around a pool of black water, with a metal token at the center. DC 12 Sleight of Hand or Acrobatics; success = recover the token. Failure = the water erupts, dealing 1d4 cold damage.
68: A broken supply sled is trapped beneath a stone arch, one crate split open and exposed to rain. DC 13 Athletics; success = recover 1d4 Materials. Failure = the arch shifts and buries the remaining cargo.
69: Smoke rises straight upward from beyond a ridge, but no structures appear on the horizon. DC 12 Survival; success = find a safe route marker left by travelers. Failure = approach a hostile patrol and lose an hour evading it.
70: A trench contains glass bottles of clear liquid, each marked with a different hazard symbol. DC 13 Medicine or Investigation; success = identify and keep 1d4 antiseptic doses. Failure = a broken bottle releases caustic vapor for 1d6 acid damage.
71: A concrete doorway stands alone in a field, its frame vibrating with Veil energy. DC 13 Arcana; success = stabilize the disturbance and pass safely. Failure = a cold gust extinguishes mundane lights and triggers combat.
72: Small birds nest in an abandoned helmet and mimic the sound of a distress call. DC 12 Animal Handling; success = calm them and find a supply pouch beneath the nest. Failure = their calls draw an encounter.
73: Shallow tracks lead to a basin of berries beside a dry creek. DC 12 Nature; success = identify safe fruit and gain 1d4 Rations. Failure = the berries are toxic; become Poisoned until the next short rest.
74: A trail passes beneath a shelf of cracked rock, with old chalk marks showing where travelers ran. DC 13 Perception; success = find a safe route around it. Failure = falling stones deal 2d6 bludgeoning damage and block the trail.
75: A medical case is bolted to a tree whose roots have grown around the latch. DC 13 Thieves' Tools; success = recover a healer's kit and 1d4 doses of medicine. Failure = the case springs open in a cloud of blinding dust.
76: Orderly footprints cross a dry streambed and stop at a sheer wall. DC 12 Investigation; success = locate a concealed side passage and save an hour. Failure = search too long and lose 1 hex.
77: A brass compass spins whenever it points toward the nearest Veil seep. DC 12 Arcana or Survival; success = use it to route around the seep. Failure = follow its needle into unstable ground.
78: A roadside memorial's lantern still glows faintly behind cracked glass. DC 12 Religion; success = find a safe resting place marked by the memorial. Failure = the light goes out and the next rest location worsens by one category.
79: A footbridge has been rebuilt with mismatched boards stamped with Drafter crew marks. DC 12 Investigation; success = identify the stable crossing. Failure = a board breaks and a traveler takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
80: Wild herbs grow in a ring of cold ashes near a makeshift field dressing station. DC 13 Medicine or Nature; success = prepare a poultice that removes Frightened or grants Advantage on the next save against fear. Failure = the herbs crumble to dust.
81: A buried cable pulses blue beneath the trail, leading toward a ruined power station. DC 13 Tinker's Tools; success = safely recover a charge worth 1 Bastion Resource. Failure = the cable discharges for 2d6 lightning damage.
82: A windbreak of dead trees shelters several folded bedrolls and a sealed food tin. DC 12 Perception; success = recover the hidden Rations. Failure = disturb Veil-touched insects and take 1d4 poison damage.
83: A shallow lake reflects the party a heartbeat late; the far shore is obscured by mist. DC 13 Arcana; success = find a safe route along the eastern bank. Failure = become disoriented and lose 1 hex.
84: A cracked pillar lists names beneath a fresh layer of soot. DC 12 History or Investigation; success = find the named traveler's abandoned pack nearby. Failure = a gust carries away the trail markers.
85: A cargo pod is lodged in a marshy bank, its emergency beacon still blinking. DC 13 Athletics or Tinker's Tools; success = recover 1d4 Munitions and silence it. Failure = the beacon summons a hostile patrol and triggers combat.
86: A narrow service tunnel is lined with smooth white stones that grow warm underfoot. DC 12 Survival; success = emerge beyond the hazard without losing time. Failure = take the wrong fork and lose 1 hex.
87: Cracked clay is covered in tracks that lead toward a dry well. DC 13 Survival; success = find a safe water source. Failure = the crust collapses and swallows 1d4 Rations in the mud.
88: A watch post's locked drawer contains a brass insignia and a folded map. DC 13 Thieves' Tools; success = recover the map and gain Advantage on the next navigation check. Failure = the drawer alarm sounds and triggers combat.
89: Luminous moss grows only on the north side of stones, even beneath the clouded sky. DC 12 Nature; success = keep direction through the fog. Failure = follow a false glow and lose 1 hex.
90: A damaged waterwheel turns beside a dry stream; its axle conceals a watertight compartment. DC 12 Tinker's Tools; success = find 1d4 Rations and a sealed letter. Failure = the wheel collapses with a loud crash.
91: Thorn bushes bear bright fruit above a carpet of shed quills and old blood. DC 13 Nature; success = gather 1d4 safe Rations. Failure = take 1d4 piercing damage and the fruit proves inedible.
92: Paper boats fill a roadside drain, each folded around a name and a date. DC 12 Religion; success = locate a hidden coin pouch beneath the memorial. Failure = the paper dissolves in sudden rain, imposing Disadvantage on the next navigation check.
93: A tilted slab bridges a narrow chasm, balanced on a single point. DC 13 Acrobatics; success = cross carefully. Failure = it tips; lose 1 hex and take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
94: Clean bandages hang above a trail marker beside a note asking travelers to leave supplies for the next person. DC 12 Investigation; success = find medicine hidden nearby. Failure = a snare catches the nearest traveler for 1d4 damage.
95: A faint chime comes from beneath a mound of snow, ash, or leaves. DC 13 Perception; success = uncover a bell and a pouch of Hollowed Residuum. Failure = a burst of freezing air deals 1d6 cold damage.
96: A cracked ventilation stack exhales warm air over a dry underground chamber. DC 12 Survival; success = find safe shelter and improve the rest location by one category. Failure = choking dust fills the passage and costs an hour.
97: Carved arrows lead to a cliff edge where a rope ladder descends to a lower trail. DC 13 Athletics; success = descend safely and save half a day's travel. Failure = the ladder snaps and the party loses 1 hex backtracking.
98: An open toolbox lies beneath a tree, tools laid out beside a half-finished repair. DC 12 Investigation; success = recover a usable set of Tinker's Tools. Failure = a concealed spring releases corrosive dust for 1d6 acid damage.
99: A clear pool lies inside a ring of stones matching a mark on the party's map. DC 13 Arcana or Nature; success = each traveler who drinks regains one expended Hit Die. Failure = the stones flare and each drinker takes 1d4 force damage.
100: A beacon shines from a ruined tower, visible across miles of open ground. DC 13 Tinker's Tools or Arcana; success = gain a safe route and 1 Bastion Resource. Failure = the signal draws a hostile encounter.
